What a receiver sees in its list. A room with three of these in it is the normal case, and \"Pixel 7\" three times is no use to anybody.
HLG10 on every streaming target, asked for before the session exists. If this phone will not give a 10-bit session the app falls back and the status line says so.
What the HX encoder is allowed. Chosen against the wire rather than the picture: a dropped frame is worse than a soft one.
How long the director holds before it will consider moving, and how long the move itself takes. Zero rack is a snap, for anybody who wants the phone to behave like a phone.
How faint an edge still counts, and what colour to mark it. Monitor only; none of it reaches the stream.
Every step, every control change and every refusal, written as it happens. This is the only instrument that reaches a phone with no cable attached.

Turn USB tethering on and the phone becomes a network interface on the computer — a private link at USB speed, with none of a hall\'s Wi-Fi in the way. Full NDI at 1080p is about 125 Mbit/s, which a cable carries without noticing and a shared access point does not.

This app cannot be the phone\'s \"Webcam\" USB option, and no third-party app can be: that is a system app, and presenting the phone as a UVC camera needs a privileged permission with no public API behind it. It would also be a step down — UVC is 1080p30 of 8-bit YUV, and this app already makes 10-bit HEVC. The cable is worth having for its bandwidth, not for its protocol.

The longest side the camera is asked for, offered from what this phone\'s lenses actually publish. It decides the recording and the stream together, and it takes effect when the camera next opens. Higher costs bitrate: NDI HX at 4K needs about four times as much to look the same, and the far end of a hall\'s Wi-Fi is where that gets spent.

How many frames a second are written to the file and sent down the wire. 24 is film; 25 and 50 belong beside a 50Hz mains and 30 and 60 beside a 60Hz one; 50 and 60 are what to shoot if it will be slowed down. The list is what this phone\'s lenses publish and will hold steady. It takes effect when the camera next opens, and it sets the longest shutter the zones will offer: a shutter longer than a frame cannot be held at the frame rate.

Ten bit is HEVC Main10 with an HLG description, and it is what this phone\'s encoder and sensor can both do. Eight bit is there for a receiver that will not take ten. Resolution decides the recording and the stream together; the list is what this phone\'s lenses actually publish. Both take effect when the camera next opens.
